analysis.title_zh: 模型能否运行于 AWS Trainium？通过 torch-neuronx model support Space 查询
analysis.summary: 公告介绍 torch-neuronx model support Space，用于查询 Hub 热门模型能否不经修改运行于 AWS Trainium，并提供自行运行的脚本。其默认 Selected 视图展示按下载量和趋势分数挑选的模型，列出运行结果及模型分片使用的 Trainium 核心数。适用于模型兼容性初筛与复现准备；原文未宣称所有 Transformers 模型均已验证可运行，也未提供完整性能对比。[S1]
analysis.application: 建议：【科研迁移建议】将该 Space 用作科研模型迁移至 AWS Trainium 前的兼容性筛查入口，再结合提供的脚本验证自己的模型与任务。【官方说明】该工具展示所选模型能否不经修改运行及其运行结果；所给资料没有具体模型的验证结果，不能据此推定迁移成功或性能提升。[S1]

steps.text: 查看 Space 默认打开的 Selected 视图，了解按 Hub 下载量和趋势分数挑选的模型。
steps.evidence: The Space opens on the Selected view: our own selection of models picked among the top models on the Hub by downloads and by trending score.

evidence: The torch-neuronx model support Space answers that question for the most popular models on the Hub.
It tells you whether a model runs unmodified on Trainium, and gives you the script to run it yourself.
The Space opens on the Selected view: our own selection of models picked among the top models on the Hub by downloads and by trending score.
